mapper.sql: select id, config_code, site_code, page_name, description, config_value, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from config_center
mapper.select:
and config_code ilike '%' || #{configCode} || '%' and site_code = '' and upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) and page_name ilike '%' || #{pageName} || '%'
order by page_name, config_code, site_code
select distinct page_name from config_center order by page_name
mapper.insert: insert into config_center (config_code, site_code, page_name, description, config_value, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{configCode}, #{siteCode}, #{pageName}, #{description}, #{configValue}, #{createBy}, localtimestamp, #{createBy}, localtimestamp)
mapper.update: update config_center set config_code = #{configCode}, site_code = #{siteCode}, page_name = #{pageName}, description = #{description}, config_value = #{configValue}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id}
